name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'render' domain + 'phase_banner_frame' descriptor exactly captures the role: paints one frame of the PLAYER/ENEMY TURN phase banner (two sprite halves) into the battle render workspace and blits it to the mode13h surface. Called per frame by the slide-in/out animators. No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Render one frame of the PLAYER/ENEMY TURN phase banner: alloc+blit the two banner halves (main + fixed corner) into the battle render workspace, blit the visible region to the mode13h primary surface, wait one BIOS tick, then free both sprite buffers.
logic_summary: ws = data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr + 0x8088 (render workspace). left_buf = fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk(ui_anim_sprite_sheet, ws, 0x1c8, 0x55 - x_offset, 0x52, banner_sprite_id) -- main banner sprite (slides from left/centre). right_buf = fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk(ui_anim_sprite_sheet, ws, 0x1c8, x_offset + 0xa5, 0x52, 0x51) -- fixed corner sprite (slides to the right). fd2_blit_rectangle(0xa0504, 0x140, ws, 0x1c8, 0x138, 0xc0) copies the workspace to the visible mode13h region (first pixel 0xA0504, stride 320, 312x192). fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks(1) for frame pacing. fd2_cleanup_dialog_sprite_buffer(left_buf, ws, 0x1c8) and (right_buf, ws, 0x1c8) free the two scratch sprite buffers. x_offset controls how far each half is off-centre (0 settled .. 0x64).

params.name: x_offset
params.semantics: Horizontal slide offset of the two banner halves from their settled centre positions. Main half painted at column 0x55 - x_offset, corner half at column x_offset + 0xa5. Callers pass frame_iter*0x19 (0..0x64) for the slide animation plus the literals 1 and 0 for final settling.
params.reason: Accurately names the value's role (per-frame horizontal slide offset). No address residue; matches both caller call sites.

params.name: banner_sprite_id
params.semantics: Sprite id of the main banner half: 0x50 = PLAYER TURN, 0x52 = ENEMY TURN. Passed through unchanged from each animator's own banner-id parameter. The corner sprite id 0x51 is hardcoded and not driven by this param.
params.reason: Correctly identifies the param as the banner sprite selector; matches caller usage (slide_in/out forward their banner_sprite_id). No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: blits the assembled banner frame to the VGA mode13h primary surface and frees the two temporary sprite buffers.
